text: The average American home has over four thousand dollars of stuff it never uses.

Render dot com runs it all: the app, every shop, the database, and the workflows that power it all
Channel Three tells the agent about a product: the price new, and the maker's own photos, and descriptions
Kernel gives the agent real browsers in the cloud, to search resale marketplaces and the web, even signed in to the seller's own third party accounts.
And PayPal moves every dollar. Sellers connect in a tap, buyers can pay later, the money's held until it arrives, and refunds and disputes are handled.
